notice: Exported text is not an audit. Scores intentionally null. Review independently before and after rewriting. Reference records must not be overwritten accidentally.

rubric.note: Subjective internal editorial ratings with evidence; not an automatic humour metric or an independent live review.

cards.title: Cause for Celebration
cards.instruction: Interpret every development as a reason to celebrate. Find victory in setbacks, warnings, and bad news.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The power's out! Our candle collection finally gets its premiere.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We don't own candles.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A shopping trip with a purpose!

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The shops have no power either.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful. The whole town's joining in.

cards.title: Cause for Celebration
cards.instruction: Interpret every development as a reason to celebrate. Find victory in setbacks, warnings, and bad news.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our flight's cancelled. We've been given a bonus airport day.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The hotel won't refund us.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then our room will stay beautifully clean.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We won't be in it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our most restful holiday yet. Even the bed gets a break.

cards.title: Practical Realist
cards.instruction: Accept any unusual premise without debate. Focus immediately on schedules, costs, safety, and what must happen next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: If the ceiling's talking, does it need a microphone for the meeting?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're not surprised the ceiling talks?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm concerned the people under the balcony won't hear.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It only speaks in prophecy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fine. Can it predict the parking bill?

cards.title: Practical Realist
cards.instruction: Accept any unusual premise without debate. Focus immediately on schedules, costs, safety, and what must happen next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your dragon can stay in the flat. Which meter measures its heating?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It breathes fire.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then it pays the gas bill.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It insists on being called Your Majesty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put that on the standing order.

cards.title: The Important Thing
cards.instruction: Choose one ordinary object, phrase, or rule and treat it as vitally important. Keep bringing the scene back to it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nobody moves out until I find the paperclip from my desk.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The removal van is charging by the hour.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then make the driver help look.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The landlord wants the keys.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: He can have the building. I want the paperclip.

cards.title: The Important Thing
cards.instruction: Choose one ordinary object, phrase, or rule and treat it as vitally important. Keep bringing the scene back to it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You changed 'regards' to 'best regards' in my email.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I also got us the contract.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We can discuss that after removing 'best.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's worth a million pounds.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then they should respect my regards as they were.

cards.title: The Grand Design
cards.instruction: Treat coincidences and interruptions as parts of a larger plan. Connect everything with absolute conviction.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Two red buses and now your red scarf. We're being directed somewhere.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I wear this every day.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then they've been preparing you for years.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My phone's ringing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Answer it. The timetable's getting impatient.

cards.title: The Grand Design
cards.instruction: Treat coincidences and interruptions as parts of a larger plan. Connect everything with absolute conviction.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The lift stopped on three. There are three of us. This is arranged.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There are four of us.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One of us is the messenger.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's stopping on four now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Message received. We stay together.

cards.title: Default Decision-Maker
cards.instruction: Take charge of every small practical choice, treating speed and efficiency as proof that you should remain in charge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've ordered everyone's sandwiches. We saved six minutes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm vegetarian.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've already removed your ham. Seven minutes saved.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could I choose next time?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You could, but I've ordered next time too.

cards.title: Default Decision-Maker
cards.instruction: Take charge of every small practical choice, treating speed and efficiency as proof that you should remain in charge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Chairs face the window. I've moved them while you were deciding.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The speaker's at the other end.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then moving the speaker is quicker than moving twelve chairs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's already speaking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll rotate the room during the applause.

cards.title: Temporary Authority
cards.instruction: Project brisk confidence through the routine, as though any hesitation would reveal that your authority is only temporary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm covering reception until two. Deliveries now use the side door.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They've always used the front.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And we must be decisive during this transition.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The receptionist will be back in five minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then knock twice. We haven't time to print the new signs.

cards.title: Temporary Authority
cards.instruction: Project brisk confidence through the routine, as though any hesitation would reveal that your authority is only temporary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: While the teacher's out, I'm monitoring silence.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She asked you to hold her keys.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A quiet responsibility. Stop jingling your pencil.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's coming back.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. I need to brief her on our progress.

cards.title: There’s a Right Way
cards.instruction: Correct how ordinary tasks are done, emphasizing tiny standards that only a true professional would notice.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Those towels need folding with the seams inside.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody sees them in the cupboard.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I do. That's why I'm qualified to stack them.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I close the cupboard?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: After you level the third towel. Doors don't correct technique.

cards.title: There’s a Right Way
cards.instruction: Correct how ordinary tasks are done, emphasizing tiny standards that only a true professional would notice.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: All the mug handles must face four o'clock.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're going in the dishwasher.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. A professional loading angle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The spray comes from below.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then it deserves a properly presented underside.

cards.title: Regular Around Here
cards.instruction: Act like a longtime insider by recognizing routines, offering shortcuts, and treating unfamiliar details as recent changes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've moved my usual table at this café.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We've only opened today.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, much fresher since my last visit.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What would you like?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My usual. Let's see whether you've changed that too.

cards.title: Regular Around Here
cards.instruction: Act like a longtime insider by recognizing routines, offering shortcuts, and treating unfamiliar details as recent changes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Where's the hook I always use at this club?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's the cleaner's cupboard.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: They've reorganised again. Typical.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Have you been here before?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before all these changes, obviously.

cards.title: Let Me Show You
cards.instruction: Turn each simple task into a lesson. Demonstrate, supervise, and correct as though experience has made you indispensable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me demonstrate how to tie that parcel.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've already tied it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Untie it. Learning begins with observation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's going to be opened anyway.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then stay for my lesson on receiving a parcel.

cards.title: Let Me Show You
cards.instruction: Turn each simple task into a lesson. Demonstrate, supervise, and correct as though experience has made you indispensable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you make tea, watch my wrist with the kettle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've made tea for twenty years.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you'll appreciate the advanced pour.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've finished the tea.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Now make one under supervision.

cards.title: Keeper of the Details
cards.instruction: Act outwardly helpful while controlling the small information, supplies, or access everyone needs to proceed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Happy to open the supply cupboard. Which project is this for?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We just need batteries.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll need to know which drawer to authorise.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We'll buy some.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. I have the petty-cash key too.

cards.title: Keeper of the Details
cards.instruction: Act outwardly helpful while controlling the small information, supplies, or access everyone needs to proceed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've got the room-booking list. When do you want your meeting?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The room's empty now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. I know why.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can we use it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As soon as I've decided whether it should stay empty.
